findings.question: Electoral roll entry (Who is entitled to vote where): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: la liste des électeurs inscrits aux registres de la population mentionne le nom, les prénoms, la date de naissance, la résidence principale et le numéro d'identification
findings.quote_english: the list of electors registered in the population registers states the surname, first names, date of birth, main residence and identification number
findings.value: liste des électeurs inscrits aux registres de la population (list of electors registered in the population registers)
findings.title: Code électoral (Art. 10), consolidated text
findings.note: Official consolidated Electoral Code on the Justel portal (Art. 10 §2); §1 says the municipal college of mayor and aldermen draws up this list on the 80th day before the election. The page has amendment markers ([2 ...]) around this text; plain curl gets 'Request Rejected' but WebFetch retrieved it.

review.established: liste des électeurs (the list of electors, drawn from the population registers)
review.reason: curl got a bot-challenge page, but WebFetch read the Electoral Code text and found the quote verbatim in Art. 10 §2; it names the list of electors and its fields, nothing more specific.

findings.question: Election management and results (Candidate lists, polling logistics and results tabulation systems): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: MARTINE est une plateforme utilisée par différents acteurs durant le processus électoral.
findings.quote_english: MARTINE is a platform used by various actors during the electoral process.
findings.value: MARTINE (platform used during the electoral process)
findings.title: Logiciel électoral
findings.note: The same page says a key part of MARTINE is the electronic transmission of results from the canton main offices to the central authority on election day; it does not name who hosts it.

review.reason: The elections.fgov.be page has the sentence verbatim and calls MARTINE the platform used in the electoral process, notably to send results electronically to the central authority.

findings.question: Intelligence services (Intelligence holdings and case files): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: La loi du 29 mars 2024, portant création de la banque de données commune « Terrorisme, Extrémisme, Processus de Radicalisation » (BDC T.E.R.), est désormais en vigueur.
findings.quote_english: The law of 29 March 2024 creating the common database 'Terrorism, Extremism, Radicalisation Process' (CDB T.E.R.) is now in force.
findings.value: banque de données commune « Terrorisme, Extrémisme, Processus de Radicalisation » (BDC T.E.R.) (common database Terrorism, Extremism, Radicalisation Process)
findings.title: Entrée en vigueur de la loi BDC T.E.R.
findings.publisher: OCAM (Organe de coordination pour l'analyse de la menace)
findings.note: OCAM's own site; this is a joint database shared by intelligence, police and other services, not the intelligence services' own case files. WebFetch failed on the TLS certificate chain, but curl fetched the page.

review.established: BDC T.E.R. (banque de données commune « Terrorisme, Extrémisme, Processus de Radicalisation »)
review.reason: The OCAM page has the quote verbatim and names the common database set up by the law of 29 March 2024; the quote names the database but does not say it belongs to the intelligence services as such.

findings.question: Police information systems (Investigations, wanted persons and national police databases): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: La Banque de données Nationale Générale. Il s’agit de la banque de données policière qui contient les données visées à l’article 44/5 de la LFP et
findings.quote_english: The General National Database. This is the police database that contains the data referred to in Article 44/5 of the Police Function Act and
findings.value: Banque de données Nationale Générale (General National Database, BNG)
findings.title: Rapport du contrôle restreint de l'Organe de contrôle ... traitements dans la BNG (DIO23001)
findings.publisher: Organe de contrôle de l'information policière (COC)
findings.note: Report of the police information supervisory body, a different URL from the earlier CON23005_NL cite; the value here is the BNG alone, without the basic databases.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim in the Organe de contrôle PDF, where it is a footnote defining the BNG as the police database holding the data in art. 44/5 LFP.

findings.question: Police information systems (Investigations, wanted persons and national police databases): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: est le ministre de l’Intérieur. Pour le traitement de ces données à caractère personnel et informations en matière de police judiciaire, le responsable du traitement est le ministre de la Justice.
findings.quote_english: is the Minister of the Interior. For processing these personal data and information in judicial police matters, the controller is the Minister of Justice.
findings.value: ministre de l’Intérieur (Minister of the Interior, for administrative police) and ministre de la Justice (Minister of Justice, for judicial police) as data controllers
findings.title: Rapport du contrôle restreint de l'Organe de contrôle ... traitements dans la BNG (DIO23001)
findings.publisher: Organe de contrôle de l'information policière (COC)
findings.note: These are the formal data controllers for the BNG and basic databases under Art. 44/4 of the Police Function Act, not the technical operator. The integrated police (GPI) runs the systems.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim, but it only names the data controllers (the Ministers of the Interior and Justice); the BNG name is in the text before it, not in the quote.
